   Key points:
   • The resale value on high-end espresso machines is awesome; it’s staggering for 1-group machines.
   • As for 3-groups?… It’s terrible.
   • The coffee industry values the third group...

4. [Science] The Lion vs The MVP
   Source: Barista Hustle

   • If you opened your first cafe with a nice reliable second hand LM Linea and you’re curious to know how it compares to a more modern (and more expensive) equivalent, then this blog post is for you.

   Source: Coffee Chronicler
   URL: https://coffeechronicler.com/kingrinder-k7-review/
   Key points:
   • Kingrinder K7 tries a lot of new things, and almost succeeds.
   • Except where it's most crucial.

6. [Reviews] What “Direct Trade” Means for the Farmer Who Grew Your Coffee
   Source: CoffeeGeek
   URL: https://coffeegeek.com/blog/farming/what-direct-trade-means-for-the-farmer-who-grew-your-coffee/
   Key points:
   • Direct trade, fair trade, commodity: three labels, three very different promises.
   • Learn what they actually mean for the farmers behind your morning cup.

7. [Origin] Edward Choo
   Source: Not a Barista
   URL: https://notabarista.org/edward-choo/
   Key points:
   • Edward Choo didn’t grow up loving coffee.
   • Like many kids in Malaysia, his drink of choice was Milo.
   • Whenever his parents ordered coffee at a local kopitiam, he would secretly take a sip out of curiosity.

8. [Origin] Jimmy Adame
   Source: Not a Barista
   URL: https://notabarista.org/jimmy-adame/
   Key points:
   • A life told in coffee, chaos, and second acts.
   • A 14-year-old kid at a Michigan farmer’s market.
   • Flannel and Neff beanies everywhere.
   • He points at the board, orders what he thinks is a blackberry-milk-chocolate latte.
